ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached diagram shows a generator labeled G on the left feeding a bus. A transformer labeled T is connected from this bus toward a right-side bus/network, and an arrow on the right indicates transmitted power flow to the right. There is also a lower connection between the buses labeled z = 0. Reasoning: The question asks which type of power is transmitted in transformer T. In this simple power-flow network, the transformer transfers useful real power from the generator side to the receiving side. Useful real power is active power. Therefore, the power transmitted in transformer T is active power.
